title.zh: 修改此前菲律宾委员会所颁布法律中所有出现“菲律宾群岛政府”字样的条款，以“菲律宾群岛政府”字样替换之，并相应调整所有岛屿政府官员头衔的法案
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ALL ACTS HERETOFORE ENACTED BY THE PHILIPPINE COMMISSION IN WHICH THE WORDS "THE GOVERNMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGO" OCCUR, BY STRIKING OUT SAID WORDS AND INSERTING IN LIEU THEREOF THE WORDS "THE GOVERNMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS," AND CHANGING THE TITLES OF ALL INSULAR GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS TO CONFORM WITH THIS AMENDMENT.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ALL ACTS HERETOFORE ENACTED BY THE PHILIPPINE COMMISSION IN WHICH THE WORDS "THE GOVERNMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGO" OCCUR, BY STRIKING OUT SAID WORDS AND INSERTING IN LIEU THEREOF THE WORDS "THE GOVERNMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS," AND CHANGING THE TITLES OF ALL INSULAR GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS TO CONFORM WITH THIS AMENDMENT.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi tất cả các đạo luật trước đây do Ủy ban Philippines ban hành, trong đó xuất hiện cụm từ “Chính phủ Quần đảo Philippines”, bằng cách gạch bỏ cụm từ này và thay thế bằng cụm từ “Chính phủ Quần đảo Philippines”, đồng thời điều chỉnh tiêu đề chức danh của tất cả quan chức Chính phủ Đảo cho phù hợp với sửa đổi này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติทั้งหมดที่ผ่านมาซึ่งคณะกรรมาธิการฟิลิปปินส์ได้ตราขึ้นซึ่งมีคำว่า“รัฐบาลหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์”โดยตัดคำดังกล่าวออกและแทนที่ด้วยคำว่า“รัฐบาลหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์”และเปลี่ยนชื่อตำแหน่งเจ้าหน้าที่รัฐบาลเกาะทั้งหมดให้สอดคล้องกับการแก้ไขนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah semua undang-undang sebelumnya yang diundangkan oleh Komisi Filipina yang memuat frasa “Pemerintah Kepulauan Filipina”, dengan mencoret frasa tersebut dan menggantinya dengan frasa “Pemerintah Kepulauan Filipina”, serta mengubah judul jabatan semua pejabat pemerintah insular agar sesuai dengan perubahan ini
title.ms: Akta mengubah semua Akta yang sebelum ini diwartakan oleh Suruhanjaya Filipina yang memuat perkataan “Kerajaan Kepulauan Filipina” dengan membuang perkataan tersebut dan menggantikannya dengan perkataan “Kerajaan Kepulauan Filipina” serta mengubah tajuk jawatan semua pegawai kerajaan pulau supaya selaras dengan pindaan ini

text.en:
All Acts heretofore enacted by the Philippine Commission in which the words "The Government
of the Philippine Archipelago" occur are hereby amended by striking out said words and inserting in lieu
thereof the words "The Government of the Philippine Islands," which shall hereafter be the official title of
said Government, in conformity with the Act of Congress approved July first, nineteen hundred and two.

The titles of all officials of the Government of the Philippine Islands are hereby amended by
striking out the word "Archipelago" wherever it occurs in such titles and inserting in lieu thereof the word

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 24, 1903.
